court_record.dd: 6.5/10: durable-shrink centerpiece; ACA cliff in guidance; volumes trend-not-spike; labor normalized; CMS-2449 = the real overhang
court_record.red_team_fable: APPROVE-MODIFIED with three convictions: (1) OCF QUALITY — ~$1.0B of the +$2.1B FY25 jump is WORKING-CAPITAL TIMING (AR drag collapse +$705M swing while revenue grew $5B; Q1-26's own MD&A: +$314M WC); the buyback ran 131% OF FCF (~$3.1B debt/WC-funded); 'falling 2.84x' was a FORWARD-estimate artifact (trailing ~3.0x, Q1 re-rising ~3.07x) -> sustainable shrink 6-6.5% at flat 3.0x, not 7%+; (2) THE DD'S SDP GUIDE WAS STALE — January's -$250-400M was updated APRIL-24 to -$50-250M (Georgia grandfathered, Texas 'Atlas' REINSTATED) and the stock fell to $357 AFTER the guide IMPROVED because the May-20 NPRM prices the 2028+ FINAL-RULE tail: audited gross SDP revenue $6.2B (grew +$1.8B in 2yrs; net EBITDA benefit UNDISCLOSED, bracketed ~16-23% of EBITDA) -> the harsh-rule tail is $280-330, NOT the DD's $360 'floor' (that was just June's traded low); (3) MARGIN — 20.6% = the decade's highest ex-COVID reading, and a large minority of FY23->25 EBITDA growth sits ON the attacked SDP stream; PTC framing corrected: EPTCs are DEAD and in the FY26 base (Q1 uninsured admissions +15.5% = the cliff materializing in guidance), so FY27 consensus is honest shrink-arithmetic, not binary-dependent; (4) FORM 4s CLEAN — 35 filings parsed; the scary Frist 36.6M entries = J-code internal redistribution (net -0.2%); zero open-market selling post-de-rate (and zero buying at $357).
court_record.adjudication: accepted in full; the rule-not-print re-keying is the ruling's spine

quant_pass_2026_07_07.premise_correction: CMS-2449 is STATUTORY implementation (OBBBA P.L.119-21 sec.71116, signed 7/4/2025), NOT discretionary rulemaking — the Medicare-level caps, the pre-7/4/25 grandfather, and the 10pp/yr phase-down from 1/1/2028 are STATUTE that CMS cannot soften at final; only the 1/1/2029 extension layer + definitions are discretionary. MFAR (withdrawn 2021) is a FALSE analog for the core — my own red-team docket had instructed weighting it; the quant caught the error. The benign case's real legs: (a) STATUTORY near-term protection — ~60% of HCA's Medicaid sits in non-expansion states = the 110% cap, EXEMPT from the step-down; (b) discretionary-layer softening (both nearest analogs, CMS-2439 + CMS-2448, softened exactly there: a dropped aggregate cap and a tripled transition).
quant_pass_2026_07_07.price_inversion: max-entropy implied at $415.60: harsh 0.311 / base 0.337 / benign 0.352; our not-harsh edge = +9pp, INSIDE the N=6 reference-class error bars -> NO robust edge; the ONLY leg where our number beats the implied: discretionary softening ~0.50 vs ~0.35 — exactly and only the add-trigger
quant_pass_2026_07_07.cross_section: UHS most exposed (net SDP $1.34B > net income, expansion states, quantified -$432-480M/yr bite) = -27% YTD (correctly punished); THC insulated (USPI half of EBITDA) = +4% (correctly spared); HCA de-rated ~4x UHS per disclosed dollar of near-term bite = mostly SECTOR SYMPATHY under-crediting the statutory protection. RV observation logged (long-HCA/short-UHS on SDP severity) — NOT traded.
quant_pass_2026_07_07.sizing_ruling: structure UNCHANGED and better-founded: the 0.5% starter = RP_FAIR carry protected by STATUTE (not by lobby hope); do NOT upsize (no calibrated edge); the 1.0% add stays gated on the discretionary-softening tells; no adds before the 7/21 comment close or on TX-ATLAS/GA preprint news (the harsh path is state-program reversal, independent of the rule)
